programs.title: My Sister's Double Life
programs.desc: When Chelsea's sister vanishes after a late-night shift at a diner, she tries to convince the police that she's been abducted. Racing against the clock, she soon discovers that her sister's captor is now after her as well.

programs.title: Dream Horse
programs.desc: The true story of Dream Alliance, an unlikely racehorse bred by small-town bartender Jan Vokes. With very little money and no experience, Jan convinces her neighbors to chip in their meager earnings to help raise Dream and compete with the racing elites. Their investment pays off as Dream rises through the ranks and becomes a beacon of hope in their struggling community.

programs.title: What We Inherit
programs.desc: After discovering his ancestors were both pioneers and enslavers, Kacim journeys through the complexities of his American and Algerian heritage, confronting histories of conquest, slavery, and the weight of an inherited legacy.

programs.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programs.desc: A wealthy San Francisco socialite is murdered at sea, bludgeoned to death by a whisky bottle; a servant who was also staying in her room may have details that can help solve this murder.

programs.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programs.desc: A youth ministry attendee disappears aboard a cruise ship; someone in the ministry may have information on what happened; but they may be hiding important details about her whereabouts.

programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: In the sleepy town of Marlborough, where boredom and low pay fuel dreams of escape, a daring heist unfolds in the dead of night, sparking a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game between local detectives and an elusive international crime syndicate.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
